Subject: Pinecrest: request for topology & isolation evidence for Dedicated/Private

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking our call on Friday. As part of Pinecrest Systems' vendor risk review we've been asked to collect a concise packet showing how Redwood handles network-level isolation for Dedicated and Private deployments. Specifically the reviewer wants:

- A diagram showing network demarcation between control plane, dedicated customer pools, and any shared services (DNS, monitoring, image registries).
- A short narrative on how tenant traffic is fenced (routing, egress controls, sidecar/airlock patterns).
- A mapping to SIG/CAIQ controls: which controls are covered by architecture/design and which are covered by operational controls (e.g., logging, KS management).
- Any evidence stubs (sample ACLs, VPC peering configs redacted, or an annotated topology PNG/PDF).

Can you confirm if Redwood can provide a single deliverable packet by the end of next week? Also let me know if you prefer a security gateway call (we can schedule a 30-minute session).

We only need high-level diagrams and the CAIQ mapping; no raw configs.

Appreciate it —
Samantha
Samantha Perez
Senior Information Security Analyst
